title: Place
description: A point in WGS84. The projection lives in one file; this shape never changes. Bounds are checked by the rules.

precision.description: How precisely this is placed, and therefore how the map draws it. `country` is the state's own point, for where nothing finer than the polity is known; a region and a country are areas and are drawn wider and fainter than a city, never as a pin at a capital. The vocabulary is src/vocab.js's PRECISIONS and this enum is the one remaining copy of it, because a JSON Schema cannot import JavaScript.
